title: Geometrical Shapes
parentNote: Have him trace real objects at home (a book, a ball, a dice) and name their shape — it makes 2D vs. 3D obvious.
learnBullets: Naming flat (2D) shapes: circle, triangle, square, rectangle, pentagon, hexagon
Naming solid (3D) shapes: cube, sphere, cylinder, cone, cuboid
learnItFirst:
**Flat (2D) shapes** — you can draw them on paper. They have sides and corners but no thickness.

```
●        ▲          ■         ▬          ⬠           ⬡
Circle  Triangle   Square   Rectangle  Pentagon    Hexagon
0 sides  3 sides   4 sides   4 sides    5 sides     6 sides
0 corners 3 corners 4 corners 4 corners 5 corners   6 corners
```

**Solid (3D) shapes** — you can hold them, they take up space.

```
🎲          ⚽        🥫           📦        🍦
Cube      Sphere   Cylinder     Cuboid     Cone
```

**Golden Rule:** For any straight-sided flat shape, the **number of sides = number of corners**.

### 🧠 How to Solve — 3 Easy Steps
1. **Look** at the outline — is it flat (2D) or does it take up space (3D)?
2. **Count** the sides carefully, one at a time, going around.
3. **Match** — the number of corners will always equal the number of straight sides.

questions.content: Name this shape: ●
questions.why: A round shape with no corners is a circle

questions.content: Name this shape: ▲
questions.why: A shape with 3 sides is a triangle

questions.content: Name this shape: ■
questions.why: A shape with 4 equal sides is a square

questions.content: Name this shape: ▬
questions.why: A 4-sided shape with unequal sides (longer/shorter) is a rectangle

questions.content: How many sides does a triangle have?
questions.why: A triangle always has 3 sides

questions.content: How many sides does a square have?
questions.why: A square always has 4 sides

questions.content: How many corners does a triangle have?
questions.why: A triangle has 3 corners — same as its number of sides

questions.content: How many corners does a square have?
questions.why: A square has 4 corners — same as its number of sides

questions.content: Which real object looks like a circle?
questions.why: A full moon is round like a circle

questions.content: Which real object looks like a rectangle?
questions.why: A door is a tall rectangle shape

questions.content: Which shape has 5 sides?
questions.why: Penta means 5 — a pentagon has 5 sides

questions.content: Which shape has 6 sides?
questions.why: Hexa means 6 — a hexagon has 6 sides

questions.content: How many corners does a circle have?
questions.why: A circle is round and smooth, with no corners

questions.content: Which of these is a 3D (solid) shape?
questions.why: A cube takes up space and can be held — it is a solid shape

questions.content: Which real object is shaped like a cube?
questions.why: A dice has 6 equal square faces, just like a cube

questions.content: Which real object is shaped like a sphere?
questions.why: A ball is perfectly round on all sides, like a sphere

questions.content: Which real object is shaped like a cylinder?
questions.why: A can has flat circular ends and a curved side, like a cylinder

questions.content: Which real object is shaped like a cone?
questions.why: It has a pointed tip and a round base, like a cone

questions.content: How many sides does a rectangle have?
questions.why: A rectangle always has 4 sides

questions.content: ▲  ■  ●  🎲(dice) — which one is a solid (3D) shape, not flat?
questions.why: A dice is a solid (3D) cube; the others are flat (2D) shapes

questions.content: A big triangle is cut into 4 equal small triangles (like a pizza slice pattern). How many triangles can you count in total (small ones + the big one)?
questions.why: 4 small triangles + 1 big triangle made of all of them = 5

questions.content: A big square is cut into 4 equal small squares (2 rows, 2 columns). How many squares can you count in total (small ones + the big one)?
questions.why: 4 small squares + 1 big square made of all of them = 5

questions.content: Which shape has NO straight sides at all?
questions.why: A circle is made of one smooth curve, no straight sides

questions.content: Which solid shape can roll easily on the ground?
questions.why: A sphere is round all over, so it rolls smoothly

questions.content: Which solid shape has only flat faces and stacks easily, like boxes?
questions.why: A cuboid (like a box) has only flat faces, so boxes stack neatly

questions.content: How many flat faces does a cube have?
questions.why: A cube has 6 flat square faces (top, bottom, and 4 sides)

questions.content: How many corners (vertices) does a cube have?
questions.why: A cube has 8 corners where its edges meet

questions.content: If you cut a rectangle in half along its diagonal (corner to corner), you get two identical right-angle triangles. If you put those two triangles back together the way they started, which shape do you get?
questions.why: A rectangle's diagonal splits it into 2 right-angle triangles, so putting them back together remakes the rectangle

questions.content: How many corners does a hexagon have?
questions.why: A hexagon has 6 corners — same as its number of sides

questions.content: A square has 4 sides. If you cut off just ONE corner with a straight cut, how many sides does the new shape have?
questions.why: Cutting off 1 corner removes 1 corner but adds 1 new side, turning 4 sides into 5
